Calorimeter will help you understand the calorie burned in the workout session. It requires your device’s camera permission to access the workout and estimate calories burnt.
Calorimeter works best on devices with RAM >2 GB & Camera with greater than 2Mp resolution.

"We’re sorry that you’re facing this problem. The Calorie meter estimates calorie burned based on the effort you put in your workout which is captured with your device’s camera. The accurate score is based on your device’s placement and camera coverage. To fix this, we recommend you ensure the device is placed so that the camera captures your whole body. Calorie meter works best on devices with RAM >2 GB < Camera with greater than 2Mp resolution..
If you continue to face issues, we request you to write to us at care.healthinsurance@adityabirlacapital.com and our team will help resolve the issue at the earliest."
